scope: Public source recovery for both needs_evidence reports from the frozen twelve-topic discovery cohort. Current reference files cannot establish the reporter's original bytes.
exposure: The complete threads and both tempering attachments were already read. NIST file contents were visible through web retrieval. A preliminary anonymous Drive request returned HTTP 404. This is development follow-up, not prospective or blinded evaluation.
bounds: Six serial requests, 30 seconds and 16 MiB per response. Preserve failures. Do not sign in, crawl other sites, execute or unpack downloads, run simulations, or invoke Lamlet. Keep third-party bytes in target/. No automatic replay or gold admission.
